verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party built-in AI connector that 'handles that setup for you', so users can add AI features by describing them. Its Cloud backend also includes AI with 'no infrastructure setup required', which covers the core of LLM calls without self-managed provider setup. However, the docs never explicitly say provider keys are managed for you, and agent-style AI features inside generated apps are not evidenced. missing for 10: explicit statement that no provider API keys are needed, documented support for agents (not just LLM calls) in generated apps, model/provider details or usage limits, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself

citations.quote: Lovable's built-in AI connector handles that setup for you, so you can add AI features to your app by describing what you want to build.
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
